business_summary: Dualtap Co., Ltd. engages in the real estate business in Japan and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Real Estate Sales Business, Real Estate Management Business, and Overseas Real Estate Business. It plans, develops, and manages condominiums and apartments under the XEBEC brand name. The company is also involved in asset management; rental and contract management; building management; and non-life insurance agency business. Dualtap Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
